# C25804 supplier fixtures

Public EasyEDA component and JLCPCB search responses retrieved on 2026-11-02
for `C25804` / `0603WAF1002T5E`. The fixtures retain CAD geometry and fields
needed by the adapter. Unused catalog fields and signed image URLs were removed.
Stock and prices are sample values, not current quotations.

Tests mock all supplier requests and run the actual vendored CAD converters.
